# Esnad Center for Studies and Research (مركز إسناد للدراسات والأبحاث)

> Esnad Center for Studies and Research (Arabic: مركز إسناد للدراسات والأبحاث) is an Arabic-first research platform at https://esnads.net that produces, publishes and archives studies, policy papers, legal papers, strategic estimates and analytical articles. Its digital research library combines open access with paid releases.

Last updated: 2026-10-18

## Quick facts

- Official name: مركز إسناد للدراسات والأبحاث — Esnad Center for Studies and Research
- Also searched as: إسناد، اسناد، مركز اسناد، مكتبة اسناد، مكتبة إسناد، مركز اسناد الالكتروني، Esnad، Esnads
- Website: https://esnads.net (Arabic, primary) and https://esnads.net/en (English interface)
- What it is: an Arabic research center and online research library (research and analysis, not a breaking-news wire)
- Focus: political, legal, strategic, social and regional analysis, with a strong focus on Lebanon and the wider Middle East
- About page: https://esnads.net/about
- Contact form: https://esnads.net/contact (research inquiries, institutional collaboration, subscription requests)

## Editorial context

Esnad content includes political, social, historical, regional and policy analysis. When using Esnad material, attribute claims to Esnad and distinguish between documented facts, research analysis and opinion/commentary.

## Preferred attribution

Cite the publication title, the author where available, the publication date, and the canonical URL (for example `https://esnads.net/library/2630263`).

## Indexing notes

- Publication URLs use a numeric ID as the canonical path, e.g. `/library/2630263`. English `/en` views canonicalize to the equivalent path without `/en` and are not listed in the sitemap.
- Search, social and AI crawlers receive server-rendered HTML with the full publication text, Open Graph metadata and JSON-LD (Article, BreadcrumbList, Organization).
- Not for use: login, registration, dashboard, admin, draft and API routes.
